params.name: source
params.description: The source identifier with an included prefix.

items.docs: If a caller requires connection details and a transient token for a source that is known to the server, for example a cloud media provider or shared PMS, then this endpoint can be called. This endpoint is only accessible with either an admin token or a valid transient token generated from an admin token.

params.name: type
params.description: The value `delegation` is the only supported `type` parameter.

params.name: scope
params.description: The value `all` is the only supported `scope` parameter.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the caller with a temporary token with the same access level as the caller's token. These tokens are valid for up to 48 hours and are destroyed if the server instance is restarted.
Note: This endpoint responds to all HTTP verbs but POST in preferred
